{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_dupes = df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
dup_counts = df[patient_dupes]['patient_id'].value_counts()

# Display the number of patients with multiple rows and their sample_seq
print(f"Number of patients with multiple rows: {len(dup_counts)}")
print(f"Sample sequence max per patient:\n{df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().value_counts().sort_index()}")

# Confirm that highest sample_seq is always 2 (indicating re-test)
assert df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().max() == 2, "Some patients have sample_seq > 2, which contradicts the data dictionary."

# Check if all re-tests are duplicates (same site, arm, severity, age, sex, assay_batch)
df_dedup = df.groupby('patient_id').apply(lambda x: x.loc[x['sample_seq'].idxmax()])

# Check if all other columns are identical within patient
check_cols = ['site', 'arm', 'severity', 'age', 'sex', 'assay_batch']
for col in check_cols:
    if not (df_dedup.groupby('patient_id')[col].nunique() == 1).all():
        print(f"Column {col} has variation within patient after deduplication.")
        break
else:
    print("All key columns are identical within patient after deduplication.")"}
